# API-Sports

> > Comprehensive RESTful API platform providing real-time sports data, statistics, and embeddable widgets across multiple sports including Football, NFL, NBA, Formula-1, MMA, Rugby, Baseball, and more.

API-Sports offers developers access to live scores, league coverage, and historical data through well-documented endpoints with flexible subscription plans. The platform includes the API-Sports Widget Builder for creating customizable, embeddable sports data widgets with CSS styling.

## Key Topics

- RESTful sports data API
- Real-time sports statistics
- API-Sports Widget Builder
- Multi-sport coverage
- Live scores and fixtures
- League data endpoints
- Embeddable widgets
- API subscription plans
- Sports data integration
- NFL and NCAA data
- NBA statistics
- Football leagues worldwide
- Formula-1 racing data
- MMA fight data
- Widget customization with CSS

## Major Sports APIs

- [Football API](https://api-sports.io/sports/football): Football API coverage for global leagues including Albania, Algeria, Andorra
- [NFL & NCAA API](https://api-sports.io/sports/nfl): NFL & NCAA API coverage, endpoints, pricing and tutorials for USA football
- [NBA API](https://api-sports.io/sports/nba): NBA API coverage, endpoints, pricing and Widget Builder integration
- [Formula-1 API](https://api-sports.io/sports/formula-1): Formula-1 API coverage, endpoints, pricing for racing data

## Combat & Team Sports APIs

- [MMA API](https://api-sports.io/sports/mma): MMA API coverage, endpoints, pricing and real-time data information
- [Rugby API](https://api-sports.io/sports/rugby): Rugby API coverage including Top 12, NRC and international competitions
- [Baseball API](https://api-sports.io/sports/baseball): Baseball API coverage including Asian Games, ABL and global leagues
- [Volleyball API](https://api-sports.io/sports/volleyball): Volleyball API coverage including African Championship and Copa ACLAV
- [AFL API](https://api-sports.io/sports/afl): AFL API coverage, endpoints, pricing for Australian Football data

## Developer Tools

- [Widget Builder](https://api-sports.io/widgets): Widget Builder tool for creating embeddable sports data widgets with CSS

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://api-sports.io/terms): Terms and conditions for API-Sports services under French law
